messages:
miguel_support: Escalating: Nimbus onboarding stuck — embed ingestion returning 502s for new trial account. Customer has ~2B tokens queued, trial expires in 48h. Raising priority to P1 for CS handoff.

jordan_csm: Thanks Miguel. Can you drop the customer id + sample logs? I'll prep comms for renewal and exec stakeholders.

miguel_support: customer: nimbus-prod-451; logs:
```
ERROR 2026-03-22T14:22:01Z embed-ingest failed status=502 upstream=timeouterr
trace id=abc123
```
We tried requeue + restart of worker pool, still 502s.

ankit_se: Looking now. What model + endpoint? Any rate-limit or quota spikes?

miguel_support: endpoint: /v1/embeddings/redwood-embed-1; pool: ded-12-eu. Cloud metrics show short bursts but below quota. No 429s in logs.

sara_cs: Jordan/I'll own customer comms. Proposed comms plan: 1) immediate triage note with ETA 2h, 2) daily status updates until resolved, 3) offer 7-day trial extension if unresolved. Draft below — pls edit.

sara_cs: DRAFT EMAIL:
```
Subject: Update on your Redwood embed ingest — were on it
Hi Team,

Were investigating intermittent 502s affecting your embed ingest. Our engineers are actively triaging; next update in 2 hours. We will extend your trial if needed and provide a mitigation plan to prevent recurrence.

Thanks for your patience,
Sara (Redwood Customer Success)
```

jordan_csm: Good plan. @ankit_se can you confirm ETA to mitigation and whether we should route to a fallback model? Also include any customer-facing mitigations (reduced batch size, retries).

ankit_se: ETA ~90-120m to identify root cause. Short-term mitigation: reduce batch size to 1 and enable exponential retry/backoff at client. If that doesn't help, failover to 'redwood-embed-1-small' (lower throughput) as a fallback. Ill patch a config snippet in the ticket.

lina_manager: Noted. Ill loop in Dedicated infra for a controlled pool restart at the 30m mark if errors persist. @sara_cs @jordan_csm please prepare an exec-facing note — renewal risk elevated.

sara_cs: Exec note template added to checklist:
```
Key risk: ingestion stability -> Renewal risk: ELEVATED
Mitigation: trial extension + weekly performance report until stable
Owner: Jordan (CS)
Next update: T+2h
```

miguel_support: Posting full logs + trace links to support ticket TCK-9876 and updating this thread. Tagging @ops-bot for pool metrics dump.

ops-bot: metrics dump completed: https://internal.redwood/dumps/TCK-9876 (contains CPU/GPU metrics, queue lengths, recent error traces)

jordan_csm: Plan and owners confirmed: Ankit (tech lead), Sara (customer comms), Lina (infra escalation), Jordan (exec owner). Ill ping the customer in 10m with the draft. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

miguel_support: Thanks — updating the support ticket and will add any new logs.
